position_input: resolved source position immediately before output quantization
normal_input: resolved source normal after optional native normalization; no extra normalization in primitive
tangent_input: resolved source tangent after seam-group averaging; no averaging or DMAP tangent update inferred
position_contract: roundTiesEven(f32(x*8192)); saturate signed16 X/Y, low16 Z; W untouched
direction_contract: trunc(f32(f32(direction*127)+128)); signed16 then unsigned8 saturation XYZ; W untouched
